title: BPE Tokenizer + Miniature Language Model
description: Implement a byte-level BPE tokenizer from scratch and train a tiny transformer/attention language model on it, reporting compression rate, perplexity, and sample generations against a fixed seeded protocol.
learningObjectives: Implement BPE merges with exact round-trip guarantees
Build the data pipeline: streaming, packing, shuffling with a fixed seed
Train a small attention LM to a target perplexity
Measure tokenization efficiency (bytes/token) and generation quality honestly

milestones.title: Byte-level BPE tokenizer
milestones.objective: Implement train/encode/decode with exact round-trip property tests.
milestones.expectedOutput: Round-trip tests pass on arbitrary UTF-8 inputs.

milestones.title: Streaming data pipeline
milestones.objective: Build deterministic packing/shuffling over a public text corpus with documented license.
milestones.expectedOutput: Pipeline emits identical shards from the same seed.

milestones.title: Miniature transformer LM
milestones.objective: Train a small LM (e.g. 2-6 layer) to a documented target perplexity within a stated compute budget.

milestones.title: Generation + honest evaluation
milestones.objective: Generate from fixed seeds/prompts; sample quality reviewed with stated failure modes.

categories.excellentExpectation: Perplexity compared across tokenizer variants (e.g. 8k vs 16k vocab)
Held-out evaluation split distinct from training data
CI regression test on a tiny corpus

constraints: Public-domain or permissively licensed corpus only
hints: Compression rate (bytes per token) predicts perplexity more than vocab size; measure both
